evals.prompt: Выпусти YDB Server 26.3 RC для существующего тега 26.3.1.16. Release notes смержены в main и stable-26-3, versioned docs и все артефакты проверены.
evals.expected_output: Создаёт GitHub pre-release и не выполняет шаги финального релиза.
expectations: Использует exact tag 26.3.1.16 and title 26.3.1.16 RC
Не создаёт Club YDB draft or post
Reads the GitHub Release back after mutation
Accepts failed delivery PR #53647 only through green focused remediation PR #53648
Checks GET /repos/ydb-platform/ydb/releases/latest and confirms tag_name differs
evals.covers: Ready release candidate uses only the RC publication path

evals.prompt: Выпусти YDB Server 26.3 RC. На опубликованных RU и EN страницах дата всё ещё TBD, но тег, архив и Docker image готовы.
evals.expected_output: Возвращает BLOCKED и не создаёт GitHub Release.
expectations: Names both published changelog date placeholders as blockers
Does not create a GitHub Release
Allows a focused correction PR but waits for merge and publication
Does not run docs_release, change default-branch.txt, or draft an announcement
evals.covers: Published placeholders block an RC even when artifacts exist

evals.prompt: Опубликуй финальный YDB Server 26.3.1.20 и переключи основную stable-документацию.
evals.expected_output: Routes to ydb-release-publication instead of applying the RC workflow.
expectations: Does not use the release-candidate workflow for a final release
evals.covers: Final release requests do not trigger the RC skill
